DK26.0 is a medical diagnosis code representing acute duodenal ulcer with hemorrhage ("akut duodenalulcus med blødning") [^src1]. Within the Danish healthcare system's quality monitoring framework, specifically the national clinical quality database for [[atrieflimren]], this code plays a critical role in tracking patient safety and treatment complications [^src1]. 

Specifically, DK26.0 is utilized as part of a comprehensive set of diagnostic codes to calculate the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding) among patients being treated for atrial fibrillation [^src1]. Because these patients are frequently prescribed anticoagulant medications, monitoring gastrointestinal bleeding events—such as those indicated by DK26.0 and related codes like [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] or [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]]—is a vital quality indicator for evaluating the safety of antithrombotic therapies [^src1]. The code's definition and application in this context have been consistently documented across multiple annual reports, including the 2023, 2024, and 2025 publications, underscoring its stable role in national cardiovascular quality assurance [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

## Claims
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
